    14  /-!
    15  # Clifford Algebras
    16  
    17  We construct the Clifford algebra of a module `M` over a commutative ring `R`, equipped with
    18  a quadratic form `Q`.
    19  
    20  ## Notation
    21  
    22  The Clifford algebra of the `R`-module `M` equipped with a quadratic form `Q` is
    23  an `R`-algebra denoted `CliffordAlgebra Q`.
    24  
    25  Given a linear morphism `f : M → A` from a module `M` to another `R`-algebra `A`, such that
    26  `cond : ∀ m, f m * f m = algebraMap _ _ (Q m)`, there is a (unique) lift of `f` to an `R`-algebra
    27  morphism from `CliffordAlgebra Q` to `A`, which is denoted `CliffordAlgebra.lift Q f cond`.
    28  
    29  The canonical linear map `M → CliffordAlgebra Q` is denoted `CliffordAlgebra.ι Q`.
    30  
    31  ## Theorems
    32  
    33  The main theorems proved ensure that `CliffordAlgebra Q` satisfies the universal property
    34  of the Clifford algebra.
    35  1. `ι_comp_lift` is the fact that the composition of `ι Q` with `lift Q f cond` agrees with `f`.
    36  2. `lift_unique` ensures the uniqueness of `lift Q f cond` with respect to 1.
    37  
    38  ## Implementation details
    39  
    40  The Clifford algebra of `M` is constructed as a quotient of the tensor algebra, as follows.
    41  1. We define a relation `CliffordAlgebra.Rel Q` on `TensorAlgebra R M`.
    42     This is the smallest relation which identifies squares of elements of `M` with `Q m`.
    43  2. The Clifford algebra is the quotient of the tensor algebra by this relation.
    44  
    45  This file is almost identical to `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/ExteriorAlgebra/Basic.lean`.
    46  -/
    47  
    48  @[expose] public section
    49  
    50  
    51  variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    52  variable {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    53  variable (Q : QuadraticForm R M)
    54  
    55  namespace CliffordAlgebra
    56  
    57  open TensorAlgebra
    58  
    59  /-- `Rel` relates each `ι m * ι m`, for `m : M`, with `Q m`.
    60  
    61  The Clifford algebra of `M` is defined as the quotient modulo this relation.
    62  -/
    63  inductive Rel : TensorAlgebra R M → TensorAlgebra R M → Prop
    64    | of (m : M) : Rel (ι R m * ι R m) (algebraMap R _ (Q m))
    65  
    66  /-- `Rel` as a ring congruence, used to build the quotient. -/
    67  @[no_expose] def ringCon : RingCon (TensorAlgebra R M) := ringConGen (Rel Q)
    68  
    69  end CliffordAlgebra
    70  
    71  /-- The Clifford algebra of an `R`-module `M` equipped with a `QuadraticForm` `Q`.
    72  -/
    73  @[wikidata Q674689]
    74  def CliffordAlgebra := CliffordAlgebra.ringCon Q |>.Quotient
